scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @devpocket/components && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle-extension.mjs
scripts.test:setup: npm run build && node --import tsx --test deployment/onboarding/tests/setup*.test.mjs && python -B -m unittest discover -s deployment/onboarding/tests -p setup_guest_test.py
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @devpocket/components && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.cli-proof.json
scripts.test:operations: npm run build && node --import tsx --test deployment/onboarding/tests/*.test.mjs && python -B -m unittest discover -s deployment/azure/tests -p vm_test.py && python -B -m unittest discover -s deployment/azure/probe -p test_receiver.py && python -B -m unittest discover -s deployment/azure/real -p test_real.py
